notes: AEAT Manual practico IVA 2025, Capitulo 5 'Deducciones y devoluciones', apartado 'Prorrata general', ejemplo de alquiler de viviendas y locales de negocio (paginas 137-138). SCENARIO GIVENS - the manual's stated inputs, fed to the engine and never checked against it: prior-year 'n-1' operations viviendas 12.000 EUR (exenta sin derecho) and locales de negocio 32.000 EUR (con derecho); current-year 'n' operations viviendas 20.000 EUR and locales 25.000 EUR, so the annual total volume is 45.000 EUR and the annual con-derecho volume 25.000 EUR; IVA soportado 1.280 EUR in the first three quarters and 160 EUR in the fourth. DERIVED FIGURES the manual states verbatim: provisional prorrata (32.000 / 44.000) x 100 = 72,72727%, 'El porcentaje aplicable se redondea por exceso y sera el 73%'; definitive prorrata (25.000 / 45.000) x 100 = 55,5555%, 'Se redondea en exceso = 56%'; 'Deduccion efectuada: 1.280 x 73% = 934,40'; 'Deduccion correcta: 1.280 x 56% = 716,80'; 'Exceso de deduccion: 217,60'; 'Deduccion aplicable al 4T = 89,60 - 217,60 = - 128 euros de menor deduccion o ingreso'; comprobacion anual 1.440 x 56% = 806,40. EXPECTED VALUES - only 'iva.prorrata-porcentaje' = 56 is listed below, because this map is reserved for casillas the registry engine computes and a verification expectation reconciles, and that casilla is the only one of the four the scenario touches that is input_kind=computed (formula modelo-303-iva-prorrata-porcentaje) and enrolled (modelo-303-2023-y-siguientes-reconcile-when-present). The two annual volume casillas 'iva.prorrata-volumen-total' and 'iva.prorrata-volumen-con-derecho' are input_kind=manual: they are the scenario's givens, so listing them as expected values would assert that the engine reproduces its own inputs. Modelo 303 casilla 44 (Regularizacion prorrata por porcentaje definitivo - Cuota) carries the manual's -217,60, and it is engine-produced - but by the prorrata_regularizacion source resolver under LIVA art. 105.Cuatro, from the prior-year provisional percentage and the year's cuotas soportadas, neither of which is a casilla of this revision - rather than by a registry formula, so it is input_kind=manual behind a governed binding and sits outside the registry-formula grounding relation. Its -217,60 stays pinned end to end against the real registry snapshot, domain and resolver chain by test_prorrata_regularizacion_oracle.py, test_prorrata_regularizacion_source_resolver.py and test_prorrata_regularizacion_source_mesh_enrollment.py, which carry the manual's figures as named constants quoting the pages above. No value here is derived from the registry formula under test.
